description: No name, no paperwork, no plate number written down. If he is not paid at 6pm there is nobody to pursue, and he knows that when he gets in the truck.
energy_note: He got in knowing there was no recourse.

description: Wage claims require identifying himself to an agency, which for an undocumented worker is a calculation with a second column in it.
energy_note: The complaint form asks for his status.

aspect: The most dangerous jobs pay cash
description: Demolition, roofing, asbestos, tank cleaning - work priced high precisely because it is refused by anyone with alternatives.
energy_note: Paid extra for the part that may kill him.

description: Eleven hours on a roof. The man says the cheque from the homeowner has not cleared, and to come back Thursday at the same corner. He comes back Thursday. He comes back the Thursday after that too.
energy_note: Two hundred and forty dollars, and a corner he keeps returning to.
